exact_obstruction.proof: Every degree-one split prime rho has odd norm p=1 mod 3, so rho does not divide 2. The multiplicative sextic character gives (64/rho)_6=(2/rho)_6^6=1. Thus w_64=w_1 and r_64=r_1 for every nonempty matrix index.
exact_obstruction.division_condition: The relative-strength ratio is 1 whenever r_1^2-1 is nonzero. Statement 1 ensures it is eventually bounded away from zero. Hence the frozen conjunction of statements 1 and 3 is contradicted; convergence r_1->1 through nonzero values would not repair the ratio.
exact_obstruction.smallest_claim: Smallest-norm nonunit integral sixth power coprime to 3: the smallest nonunit base norm coprime to 3 is 4, giving 4^6=4096. This is not a claim of the smallest counterexample to every possible refinement.
